en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet, tree‑lined European street with multi‑storey masonry buildings in late‑19th‑century style. The right foreground shows a large institutional building with rusticated stone ground floor, arched windows, and an ornate arched doorway. Long angled flagpoles project from the façades, but the flags themselves are not visible. A few pedestrians stand on the otherwise empty sidewalk. The scene feels official or administrative rather than residential.
